title: The Twelfth House Collects
text: The carts come back, three Years to the night, and this time the drivers have faces: yours. They have come to collect what the Twelfth House is owed. They are polite about it. They will not leave until they are paid.

options.label: Pay the Twelfth House in gold, and be done with their debt.

outcomes.text: Every House pays. The carts leave heavy. A signet ring is left behind on the Commons table.

options.label: Pay them in people, as they would prefer.

outcomes.text: Each House sends a recruit to ride on the carts. They wave as they go. The Twelfth House is satisfied for a generation.

options.label: Drive them out with steel. No House wearing your faces collects from you.

outcomes.text: Every House's Scions take to the streets. The drivers die like men and rise again like something else, and it is dawn before the last cart burns.
